Reading Name: P3.3 Remote control place frequency reference
Notes: 3 = fieldbus frequency reference. | 1 = Preset speed 0-7; 2 = Keypad; 3 = Fieldbus; 4 = AI1; 5 = AI2; 6 = PI
Set 1 for Modbus control. | 0 = I/O terminals; 1 = Fieldbus
bit 0 = Run (0 = stop); bit 1 = Direction (1 = counter-clockwise); bit 2 = Fault reset on rising edge
bit 0 = Drive ready; bit 1 = Running; bit 2 = Counter-clockwise; bit 3 = Fault active; bit 4 = Alarm active; bit 5 = Speed reference reached; bit 6 = Running at zero speed
Fault code per the manual's fault table; 0 = none.
